active_skills.description: Enters Stealth mode: hard to be seen beyond 16m, cannot be detected by enemies, gains 20% speed boost. Aim assist triggers within 4m. Cannot fire while stealthed. 1s exit delay.

active_skills.reset_condition: Knocking down an enemy within 19s after skill release resets cooldown.
CD resets when taking down an enemy within 10s after skill release.
Knockdown restores temporary Shield Points back to 70 and resets state duration.

active_skills.adjustment: Plushie can now pass through all cover including ground, building floors, and ceilings. Fixed issue where skill accidentally disabled own Gloo Walls.
Mannequin can now be placed and used on trains and rails in the Studio area of Solara.

bug_fixes: Fixed effective skill range mismatch with VFX range.
Fixed movement speed boost failing to apply.
